text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Namibian nurses yesterday criticised their salary provisions as laid down by Wage and Salary Commission recommendations (WASCOM) and warned government to avoid unnecessary confrontation.
- Bjorn von Finckenstein was last night re-elected as Mayor of Windhoek for the third year running.
- Councillor Bjorn von Finckenstein was re-elected for a record third term as Mayor of Windhoek.

- The National Assembly yesterday blamed foreign trucks for ruining Namibian roads and urged Minister of Works, Transport and Communication, Hampie Plichta to look into the possibility of introducing levies on heavy vehicles.
- Windhoek City Council yesterday elected Bjorn von Finckenstein for a third term as Mayor.
